question: Should the shipped plugin callback field `attempt` begin a formal deprecation lifecycle in this PR, or remain supported without a deprecation warning?
rationale: Repository policy requires owner-visible approval and a named compatibility/removal plan before deprecating a shipped plugin SDK contract; source inspection cannot determine that product/API intent.

options.title: Keep `attempt` supported
options.body: Remove `@deprecated`, retain all three fields, and land the additive bug fix without starting an unapproved removal lifecycle.

options.title: Approve formal deprecation
options.body: Keep the annotation only with explicit owner approval, migration documentation, compatibility coverage, and a stated removal horizon.

recommendation.title: Keep `attempt` supported
